claims.promise: Every photo and room note taken on a walk is written to durable local draft storage before the next room opens, so a crash, a Next tap, or a process kill cannot delete a finished hour of work the way Property360 and Yardi reviews describe.

evidence.finding: Property360 1-star: after spending 2hours on detailed report, upon clicking next, the app deleted everything. Yardi Inspection 1-star: finalizing an inspection with photos, the app LOST THE PHOTOS. Property Inspect critical sample includes crash mid-report.

claims.deferredReason: No draft store exists yet. Resolved when a test kills the process mid-walk and asserts every prior room photo and note reloads from disk.

claims.promise: The walk opens and finishes with no account, no email and no employer login, so a landlord who does not have a Yardi or Property Inspect seat can still complete a move-in report on the phone they already own.

evidence.finding: Property Inspect 1-star: installed the app, opened it, asked for email and password, incorrect details. Yardi Inspection is an employer Voyager plugin; enrichment shows free with no consumer IAP — the buyer is not choosing it.

claims.deferredReason: No auth surface must exist. Resolved when a test completes a full walk and PDF share with airplane mode and zero account state.

claims.promise: For each unit the landlord can open the prior move-in report beside the new move-out walk and mark differences room by room, so deposit disputes rest on the same checklist rather than on memory.

evidence.finding: The job is move-in and move-out condition evidence; cloud leaders (RentCheck) sell resident-driven inspections, while unrated offline cards claim PDF reports. The compare-per-unit handoff is the functional gap a self-managing landlord needs that a single disposable checklist does not give.

claims.deferredReason: No dual-report UI exists yet. Resolved when a test asserts a move-out walk can load the linked move-in draft and record per-room deltas.

claims.promise: The finished report leaves the phone as a signed PDF the landlord can share or save with the system share sheet or a SAF create-document action, without uploading to a vendor cloud first.

evidence.finding: Property Inspect at 2.1 stars over 42 exact reviews and 10K-plus installs draws a critical review that report upload failed due to validation error with no hint — the handoff is blocked by a server. PropertyLog at 1-plus installs declares IAP for an offline PDF shape; RentCheck at 4.7 stars over 7,200 reviews and 100K-plus installs is cloud with no Play IAP badge.

claims.deferredReason: No PDF or share path exists yet. Resolved when proof code contains ACTION_SEND or ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT / FileProvider and a test asserts a non-empty PDF bytes leave the app.

claims.promise: The landlord keeps a small portfolio of units on the phone and starts a walk from a named unit, so a second property does not require a second app install or a cloud seat.

evidence.finding: Candidate 2 names the reachable user as the landlord who manages a few units themselves — a different job from the enterprise Yardi seat, and the reason multi-unit local portfolio is in scope while team sync is not.

claims.deferredReason: No portfolio model exists yet. Resolved when a test creates two units and starts independent walks from each.
